name: Exp_ColorMomentum_AMA
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorMomentum_AMA custom indicator, which applies Adaptive Moving Average (AMA) smoothing to a Momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed momentum is rising and sell positions when it is falling, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and lot sizing based on deposit share.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMomentum_AMA自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标对动量振荡器应用自适应移动平均(AMA)平滑处理。当平滑动量上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓，具有可配置的止损、止盈和基于存款比例的仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于动量振荡器经自适应移动平均(AMA)平滑后的方向变化来判断趋势。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（动量上升趋势）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前动量值持续增加）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（动量下降趋势）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前动量值持续减少）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损(StopLoss_)和止盈(TakeProfit_)，以及动量方向反转时的反向平仓信号。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示存款比例分配。资金管理采用百分比风险模式，但缺乏基于波动率的动态仓位调整。该策略依赖单一指标信号，没有额外的过滤条件来避免震荡市中的假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in a Momentum oscillator that has been smoothed by an Adaptive Moving Average (AMA) to identify trends. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (momentum trending upward) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current momentum value continues increasing); a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (momentum trending downward) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current momentum value continues decreasing). Exit conditions include fixed point-based stop loss (StopLoss_) and take profit (TakeProfit_), plus opposite-direction close signals when momentum direction reverses. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share allocation. Money management uses a percentage risk model but lacks volatility-based dynamic position adjustment. The strategy relies on a single indicator signal without additional filters to avoid false signals in choppy markets.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Lot size or money management ratio

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格类型

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: AMA自适应平滑能有效减少动量指标的虚假信号，比简单移动平均更灵活适应市场变化
具有独立的开仓和平仓权限控制，交易灵活度高
止损和止盈参数完备，风险控制有基本框架
pros_en: AMA adaptive smoothing effectively reduces false signals from the momentum indicator, being more flexible than simple moving averages in adapting to market changes
Independent permission controls for opening and closing positions provide high trading flexibility
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 依赖单一自定义指标信号，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制，震荡行情容易频繁开平仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，风险收益比虽为1:2但绝对风险较高
没有点差过滤、波动率过滤或交易时段限制，在高点差或低流动性时段可能造成不必要的损失
cons_en: Relies on a single custom indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation or filtering, prone to frequent open/close cycles in choppy markets
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large; while the risk-reward ratio is 1:2, the absolute risk exposure is high
No spread filter, volatility filter, or trading session restrictions, which may cause unnecessary losses during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制和波动率过滤（如ATR），减少震荡市场的虚假信号
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，优化止损止盈为基于ATR的动态值而非固定点数
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation and volatility filtering (e.g., ATR) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions, and optimize stop loss/take profit to ATR-based dynamic values instead of fixed points

risk_points: 无点差过滤机制，在点差扩大时仍可能开仓导致不利成交
固定点数止损止盈不适应不同波动率环境，低波动时止损过大高波动时止盈过小
risk_points_en: No spread filter mechanism, positions may be opened during spread widening resulting in unfavorable fills
Fixed point stop loss/take profit does not adapt to different volatility environments—stop loss too large in low volatility, take profit too small in high volatility
